summary: The selected-results comparison holds. All 14 plotted genes agree in direction, and only Trh and Npy among the eight genes with published chronic-diet q-values pass registered BH FDR < 0.05. The proposal overstated a contradiction: the high-filter methods share five chronic discoveries and six genes across all tests, consistent with the paper’s summary. All 50 source hashes and sizes matched. One saved GEO page was a reCAPTCHA challenge, and the three authenticated GEO downloads supported the analysis. The corrected proposal passed validation. [Published Table 2](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0196743.t002)
openIssues: The local QC summary reports 278 discoveries. The registered DE table and gene-level bundle agree on 13.
Eight supplemental panel assignments are inferred. All 12 chronic Tukey comparisons reproduce, but the Tk1 omnibus statistic and two comparisons involving switch arms differ.
Genome-wide author coefficients and inference remain unavailable in the reviewed sources. The 14 selected directions fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum.
Dryad identifies all 20 mice in the ten registered pools. The registry and sample sheet still describe individual pool membership as unavailable.
